meta.title: Implement KV batch PutMany
meta.body_summary: Add PutMany RPC to kv.proto, regenerate protobuf code, implement batch writes on NATS store and server, update sync poller to batch KV writes, and revise interfaces/mocks for PutMany support.

perf_labels.notes: Merged in 2 minutes with self-approval and acknowledged test failures; no performance benchmark provided.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 688 changed lines across 14 files, this is a medium-sized feature addition by absolute volume. It fits a batch RPC implementation across proto, server, NATS, and sync layers, merged quickly with owner self-approval, consistent with a low-friction performance improvement.

review_details.concern_detail: Single-word 'lgtm' from the PR author; no substantive review feedback provided.
review_details.performance_claim: Batch writes via PutMany reduce RPC round trips and improve overall throughput compared to sequential Put calls.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Implementing batch RPC across protobuf, gRPC, NATS KV store, and sync poller is a multi-layer technical stack task; Codex delivered the feature without substantive review.

detection_detail.code_reading: Maintainer reviewed the diff and gave 'lgtm', implying visual approval with no changes requested.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No performance benchmark, profiler output, or before/after timing measurements included; test failures noted in PR body but not addressed.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: Body acknowledges three failing tests in pkg/sync/integrations/armis; PR was merged without fixing them.

core_change_summary.description: Added PutMany RPC definition in kv.proto, regenerated gRPC stubs, implemented PutMany on NATS KV store, added server handler, updated sync poller to use batch writes, and adjusted interfaces and mocks.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Remaining files cover mock updates and integration test adjustments; no new behavior changes.
